narrative: Between 2025-08-01T00:00:00Z and 2025-09-01T00:00:00Z, festival/holiday periods saw 187 failure events. Top correlated reason: Weather disruption. Average warehouse capacity during these events was constrained — plan buffer staffing and driver capacity.
recommendations: Pre-scale warehouse capacity by 15% and add a 15% driver buffer before festival peaks.
Add packing staff at the warehouse during peak hours.
Review end-to-end SLA checkpoints from kitchen dispatch to last-mile handoff.
Mandatory address pin validation before dispatch.
Pause SLA clock during severe weather and pre-position drivers beforehand.
Enable real-time inventory sync and low-stock alerts at affected warehouses.
